excerpt: This lease shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless Tenant provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior.
Upon expiration the lease converts to month-to-month until terminated by either party with thirty (30) days written notice.
Tenant shall be liable for all remaining rent plus a termination fee equal to three months rent and shall forfeit the security deposit.
Tenant may terminate with sixty days written notice upon payment of one and one-half months rent.
A late charge of $150 per day shall be assessed for each day rent remains unpaid after the 3rd.
A one-time late fee of $50 will be charged if rent is not received by the 5th of the month.
Landlord may deduct any amounts deemed necessary at Landlord's sole discretion. Deposit returned within 90 days.
Security deposit of one month rent returned within 21 days with itemized statement.
Tenant shall be responsible for all repairs including plumbing electrical HVAC and appliances regardless of cause.
Landlord shall maintain premises in habitable condition. Tenant responsible for minor maintenance only.
Landlord may enter the premises at any time without prior notice to Tenant.
Landlord shall provide at least 24 hours written notice before entering except in emergencies.
Subletting is strictly prohibited. Violation results in immediate lease termination and forfeiture of deposit.
Tenant may not sublet without prior written consent which may be withheld at Landlord's sole discretion.
No guest may stay more than two consecutive nights. Violation constitutes immediate grounds for eviction.
Guests may not stay more than seven consecutive days or fourteen days total per month without approval.
